nodes.name: oss-drift-check.sh
nodes.summary: Maintainer ritual script that detects source drift between the monorepo's hive-mind-core substrate and the public OSS mirror, reporting ONLY-IN-OSS (reverse-port candidates), ONLY-IN-MONO (pending exports), and DIFFERS (divergent edits) per the §7.5 sync policy.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses bash comm(1) and diff -q for deterministic file-level comparison; exit codes 0/1/2 map to clean/drift/setup-error for scripted use.

nodes.name: oss-subtree-split.sh
nodes.summary: Runs git subtree split on all packages/hive-mind-* directories to produce local inspection branches, with a hard ABORT guard that refuses to emit branches containing proprietary files (evolution-runs.ts, execution-traces.ts, improvement-signals.ts, vault.ts, compliance/); explicitly NOT a direct OSS-publish path.
nodes.languageNotes: The proprietary-file abort guard uses git ls-tree -r to inspect branch contents before allowing output, preventing silent IP leaks; the real OSS sync is a curated forward-port, not this script's output.

nodes.name: parity-check.sh
nodes.summary: Local-dev parity check that mirrors the CI mind-parity-check workflow by temporarily injecting hive-mind test files into packages/core/tests/mind, running vitest, then cleaning up; respects a .parity-allowlist file to skip already-committed port files.
nodes.languageNotes: References packages/core/src/mind/ which reflects the pre-monorepo-migration layout; the canonical substrate has moved to packages/hive-mind-core/src/mind/ per the April 2026 migration.
